title: Echo Pier
summary: Kerry takes you to an old pier at Pacifica with a great echo, and asks what word you would shout if you did not care who heard.

start.bringUp: Kerry knows an old pier at Pacifica with a great echo. Ask V to come and bring their voice, not for singing.

variations.know: Fog lies on the water around the old pier at Pacifica, so the echo comes back softly and from nowhere in particular.
variations.wants: A word that the fog will carry.

variations.know: The old pier at Pacifica has a tunnel under it, and the echo inside the tunnel is loud and rough.
variations.wants: A word that sounds good under the pier.

variations.know: You are in a sea cave at the foot of the old pier at Pacifica, and the echo bounces off the rock for a long time.
variations.wants: A word that the cave can hold.

pier.name: the old pier at Pacifica with the great echo

g1.asks: What word would you shout, if you didn't care who heard?
g1.know: You are at the old pier at Pacifica with Kerry. The echo comes back loud off the water, and the planks are old under your feet.
g1.secret: A word he shouts here is a name.

stages.label: Kerry asks V to shout on the old pier
stages.know: You are at the old pier at Pacifica, where the echo is good. Kerry is leaning on a rail beside you, waiting to hear what you shout.
stages.wants: V to shout a word and mean it.

shouted.memory: You shouted a word off the old pier at Pacifica, and the echo came back to you.

quiet.memory: You stood on the old pier at Pacifica with Kerry and said nothing into the echo.

stood-up.memory: You never came to the old pier at Pacifica, and Kerry shouted at the water alone.
